title: Reverse Engineering
description: You know the mixing result and one alchemical — use the two-colour rule in reverse to identify the other ingredient.

hints.text: The result is B+, so Blue resolved. Both ingredients must share B+ sign, with different Blue sizes. ing2 is PPP (R+L, G+L, B+L) — B+Large. So ing1 must be B+Small.
ing1 has G- (given) and B+S (deduced). Of the eight alchemicals, which has both G- and B+S? That is Nnp (R-L, G-S, B+S).
Confirm: Nnp mixed with PPP — Red signs differ (R- vs R+), Green signs differ (G- vs G+), Blue signs match with different sizes (B+S vs B+L) → B+. Answer: Nnp.
